# Taxi Lagi Bình Thuận
> Dịch vụ taxi chuyên nghiệp tại Lagi, Bình Thuận, Lâm Đồng - Hotline 0941865131 - Phục vụ 24/7

## About
Taxi Lagi Bình Thuận is a professional taxi service serving Lagi (Bình Thuận province), Lâm Đồng province, and surrounding areas in Vietnam. Operating 24/7 with a fleet of 4-seat, 5-seat, and 7-seat vehicles.

## Contact
- Phone: 0941865131
- Zalo: 0941865131
- Address: 105 Lê Minh Công, Phước Lộc, Lagi, Bình Thuận, Vietnam
- Website: https://taxilagi.io.vn/

## Services
- Taxi Nội Thành (City taxi within Lagi)
- Taxi Sân Bay (Airport transfer to Liên Khương Airport)
- Taxi Tuyến Huyện (District routes)
- Taxi Du Lịch (Tourist taxi)
- Đón Tiễn Sân Bay (Airport pickup/dropoff)

## Fleet
- Taxi 4 chỗ (4-seat sedan)
- Taxi 5 chỗ (5-seat car)
- Taxi 7 chỗ (7-seat SUV/MPV)
